name: HL_REQ_ADDL_LINKED_ENC
description: This table contains patient contact serial numbers of other patient's encounters which are linked with the request's patient encounter that should be transferred or discharged when the request is completed.

columns.name: HLR_ID
columns.description: The unique identifier (.1 item) for the request record.

columns.name: LINE
columns.description: The line number for the information associated with this record. Multiple pieces of information can be associated with this record.

columns.name: PAT_ENC_CSN_ID
columns.description: The list of linked encounters that should be transferred or discharged along with the request's patient when the request is completed.
